enriched.title: Presente Contínuo e Vocabulário Cotidiano
enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do presente contínuo para explicar situações ou consequências. Também explora vocabulário relacionado ao cotidiano e expressões úteis em inglês, com foco em exemplos práticos e contextuais.

vocabulary.definition: Used to indicate the reason for something.
examples: I didn’t go outside because of this. (Eu não saí por causa disso.)
That man is a teacher. (Aquele homem é um professor.)
The men are working. (Os homens estão trabalhando.)

vocabulary.definition: Refers to the days Monday through Friday.
examples: I usually work on weekdays. (Eu geralmente trabalho nos dias da semana.)

vocabulary.definition: Activities or services provided after the sale of a product.
examples: The company offers excellent postsale support. (A empresa oferece excelente suporte pós-venda.)

vocabulary.definition: Used to introduce a statement that contrasts with what has just been said.
examples: I was tired; even so, I finished the project. (Eu estava cansado; mesmo assim, terminei o projeto.)
She follows a daily routine. (Ela segue uma rotina diária.)

vocabulary.definition: The quality of being new, original, or unusual.
examples: The novelty of the product attracted many buyers. (A novidade do produto atraiu muitos compradores.)

vocabulary.definition: A feeling of uncertainty or lack of conviction.
examples: I doubt his story. (Eu duvido da história dele.)

vocabulary.definition: Covered or saturated with water or another liquid.
examples: My clothes are wet from the rain. (Minhas roupas estão molhadas pela chuva.)

grammar.explanation: The present continuous tense is used to describe actions happening now or temporary situations.
rules: Formed with the verb 'to be' in the present + verb ending in -ing.
Used for actions happening at the moment of speaking, temporary actions, or future arrangements.
examples: The baby is sleeping. (O bebê está dormindo.)
We’re looking for a child for adoption. (Estamos procurando uma criança para adoção.)
commonMistakes: Omitting the auxiliary verb (e.g., 'I studying' instead of 'I am studying').
Using the base form of the verb instead of -ing (e.g., 'I am study' instead of 'I am studying').

expressions.usage: Used when events happen consecutively without interruption.
examples: He won three games in a row. (Ele ganhou três jogos consecutivos.)

practiceQuestions.question: Use the present continuous to explain why you can't answer the phone.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The present continuous is used to describe an action happening at the moment.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate: 'Eu estou cozinhando agora.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: The present continuous is formed with 'to be' + verb ending in -ing.

culturalNotes: In English-speaking cultures, it's common to use the present continuous to politely indicate you're busy (e.g., 'I’m working right now').
studyTips: Practice forming sentences in the present continuous by describing your daily activities.
Listen to English conversations to observe how the present continuous is used naturally.
originalExamples: Don't ask me to sit next to Noah. I'm avoiding contact with him. (Não me peça para sentar ao lado do Noah. Estou evitando contato com ele.)
I can't participate in the project. I'm finishing another campaign. (Não posso participar do projeto. Estou terminando outra campanha.)
Please don't make so much noise. I’m studying. The baby is sleeping. (Por favor, não faça tanto barulho. Estou estudando. O bebê está dormindo.)
I need to eat something soon. I’m eating every three hours. I’m getting hungry. (Preciso comer algo em breve. Estou comendo a cada três horas. Estou ficando com fome.)
I don't have anywhere to live now. I’m travelling all the time / around the world. (Eu não tenho onde morar agora. Estou viajando o tempo todo / pelo mundo.)

warnings: practiceQuestions tem apenas 2 item(ns), recomendado mínimo de 3
